name: Tajiri (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tajiri town emblem in white: an outlined lozenge of interlaced triangles divided by a vertical bar.
history: Municipal flag of Tajiri, a town in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1889.

features.role: Tajiri town emblem — an outlined lozenge of interlaced triangles divided by a vertical bar
